   "source": [
    "# Segment Analysis: Basic Pipeline\n",
    "\n",
    "**Goal**: Learn how to use `SegmentTable` to manage time-keyed data analysis.\n",
    "\n",
    "`SegmentTable` is a container for metadata and payload data (like TimeSeries or PSDs) associated with specific time segments. It supports lazy-loading to handle large datasets efficiently.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "intro_table-001",
   "metadata": {
    "tags": [
     "lang-en"
    ]
   },
   "source": [
    "## 1. Creating a SegmentTable\n",
    "\n",
    "We'll start by loading sample data from a CSV file. This CSV defines segments with GPS start and end times.\n"
   ]

   "source": [
    "import warnings\n",
    "\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings(\"ignore\", category=UserWarning)\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings(\"ignore\", category=DeprecationWarning)\n",
    "\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "\n",
    "from gwexpy.table import SegmentTable\n",
    "\n",
    "# Resolve the sample path robustly for both repo-root and notebook-dir execution.\n",
    "csv_candidates = []\n",
    "for root in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents]:\n",
    "    csv_candidates.extend([\n",
    "        root / \"docs\" / \"_static\" / \"samples\" / \"sample_segment_data.csv\",\n",
    "        root / \"_static\" / \"samples\" / \"sample_segment_data.csv\",\n",
    "    ])\n",
    "\n",
    "sample_csv = next((path for path in csv_candidates if path.exists()), None)\n",
    "if sample_csv is None:\n",
    "    tried = [str(path) for path in csv_candidates]\n",
    "    raise FileNotFoundError(f\"Could not find sample_segment_data.csv. Tried: {tried}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "st = SegmentTable.read(str(sample_csv))\n",
    "\n",
    "print(st)\n",
    "st.display().head()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "intro_table-003",
   "metadata": {
    "tags": [
     "lang-en"
    ]
   },
   "source": [
    "## 2. Visualizing Segments\n",
    "\n",
    "You can quickly visualize the timeline of your segments.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "intro_table-004",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-05T18:54:22.453781Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-05T18:54:22.453547Z",

    }

    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "st.segments(ax=ax, label=\"Tutorial Segments\")\n",
    "plt.title(\"SegmentTable Timeline\")\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "intro_table-005",
   "metadata": {
    "tags": [
     "lang-en"
    ]
   },
   "source": [
    "## 3. Lazy Loading Payloads\n",
    "\n",
    "`SegmentTable` allows you to attach \"loaders\" to columns. Data is only loaded when actually accessed.\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "intro_table-006",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-05T18:54:22.635739Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-05T18:54:22.635498Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-05T18:54:22.641652Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-05T18:54:22.640977Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Loaded 4096 samples starting at GPS 0.0\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from gwexpy.noise.wave import gaussian\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def noise_loader(segment):\n",
    "    # Generate synthetic noise for the segment\n",
    "    duration = float(segment[1] - segment[0])\n",
    "    return gaussian(duration=duration, sample_rate=1024, t0=float(segment[0]))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Note: Use add_series_column for lazy-loadable payload data (kind='timeseries', etc.)\n",
    "st.add_series_column(\"noise\", loader=noise_loader, kind=\"timeseries\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Accessing the first row's noise (triggers loading)\n",
    "data_0 = st.row(0)[\"noise\"]\n",
    "print(f\"Loaded {len(data_0)} samples starting at GPS {data_0.t0.value}\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "intro_table-007",
   "metadata": {
    "tags": [
     "lang-en"
    ]
   },
   "source": [

    "\n",
    "You can iterate over rows or use `apply` to process data.\n"

   "source": [
    "# Calculate RMS for each noise segment\n",
    "# Use add_column for lightweight metadata results\n",
    "st.add_column(\"rms\", data=[row[\"noise\"].rms().value for row in st])\n",
    "st.display()"
   ]
